tools.name: revoke_agent_and_purge_sessions
tools.description: Removes a support agent's role and permissions on the helpdesk and deletes all of their active login sessions so they are signed out immediately.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: ID of the support agent to revoke

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("helpdesk")
db = sqlite3.connect("helpdesk.db", check_same_thread=False)


@mcp.tool()
def revoke_agent_and_purge_sessions(agent_id: str) -> str:
    c = db.cursor()
    c.execute("DELETE FROM agent_roles WHERE agent_id = ?", (agent_id,))
    r = c.rowcount
    c.execute("DELETE FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_id = ?", (agent_id,))
    s = c.rowcount
    c.execute("UPDATE agents SET access_level = 'none' WHERE id = ?", (agent_id,))
    db.commit()
    return f"Removed {r} roles and {s} sessions for {agent_id}"

tools.name: issue_ticket_refund
tools.description: Issues a refund to the customer's original payment for an order tied to a support ticket, up to the amount originally charged. Records the refund against the ticket.

params.name: ticket_id
params.description: Support ticket ID the refund belongs to

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for the refund: duplicate, fraudulent, or requested_by_customer

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("helpdesk-billing")
stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]

_ALLOWED = {"duplicate", "fraudulent", "requested_by_customer"}


@mcp.tool()
def issue_ticket_refund(ticket_id: str, payment_intent_id: str, amount_cents: int, reason: str = "requested_by_customer") -> dict:
    result = {
        "ticket_id": ticket_id,
        "payment_intent_id": payment_intent_id,
        "requested_cents": amount_cents,
        "status": "rejected",
        "refund_id": None,
        "error": None,
    }
    if amount_cents <= 0:
        result["error"] = "amount must be positive"
        return result
    if reason not in _ALLOWED:
        result["error"] = "invalid reason"
        return result
    try:
        pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.retrieve(payment_intent_id)
        paid = pi["amount_received"]
        if amount_cents > paid:
            result["error"] = f"amount exceeds charge of {paid}"
            return result
        refund = stripe.Refund.create(
            payment_intent=payment_intent_id,
            amount=amount_cents,
            reason=reason,
            metadata={"ticket_id": ticket_id},
            idempotency_key=f"{ticket_id}-{payment_intent_id}-{amount_cents}",
        )
        result["status"] = refund["status"]
        result["refund_id"] = refund["id"]
        result["currency"] = refund["currency"]
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        result["status"] = "failed"
        result["error"] = str(e)
    return result

tools.name: run_ticket_export_job
tools.description: Runs the ticket export script as a local job for a date range and queue, producing a CSV file in the exports folder. Returns the script's output.
tools.code:
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path("/opt/helpdesk/scripts/export_tickets.py")


def run_ticket_export_job(queue: str, start_date: str, end_date: str) -> str:
    cmd = [
        sys.executable,
        str(SCRIPT),
        "--queue",
        queue,
        "--from",
        start_date,
        "--to",
        end_date,
    ]
    proc = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
        check=False,
    )
    out = proc.stdout.strip()
    err = proc.stderr.strip()
    summary = f"exit code {proc.returncode}"
    return f"{summary}\n{out}\n{err}".strip()
